All three: low-heat Serial Killer mid-game votes with the forming majority and avoids a lone dissent; 077504b0 states the rule most generally with the reason (dissent only when it changes the result).
Both: Serial Killer targeted in a small endgame vote counts ballots and casts the vote that ties the tally (join an ally's or rival wagon), never a lone vote; 46e4d6bd is the more complete version.
